digest.component_or_area: store paths and sidecar location resolution
propositions: Five independent modules derive the sidecar directory location for a store, each with separate symlink resolution logic, creating maintenance risk and historical bug-per-site incidents
Push state and sync modules separately parse .git gitfile format to derive git directory and common directory, duplicating logic
A single StorePaths frozen dataclass should centralize all tracker-to-sidecar path derivations and be the only site applying os.path.realpath to tracker paths for sidecar purposes
A guard test with join-scan and definition-count checks must prevent future _rebar_dir definitions or .rebar path joins outside the owner module
All five existing call sites already resolve symlinks compositely at their callsites, so refactoring to StorePaths preserves current behaviour without converging latent divergence
